ops.title: Phase 3: land the signed-peer E2E CI job (G4), security-fixed and repathed
ops.description:
G4's signed-peer E2E CI job was built (t=0 workflow) but DEFERRED to phase 3: the module does not
compile in phases 1-2 so the suite cannot run, and its target ./trust/ moves to ./internal/trust/
in P1c. Draft at cut/p1/G4-ci.yml.draft; design in cut/p1/G4-REPORT.md; the skip->fatal
anti-vacuity fix at cut/p1/G4-trust-test.patch (P1c carries it into internal/trust's E2E tests).

BLOCKING SECURITY FIX (refuter): the draft runs signing/notary secrets on unfiltered pull_request.
This repo cuts branches in-repo via ccx vcs ship, so secrets ARE populated for non-fork PRs ->
arbitrary PR code could exfiltrate the fleet Developer ID key + notary key. Gate both
signing-secrets and trust-e2e so they NEVER run on pull_request:
if: (github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref,
'refs/tags/'))) || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'  -- feature-branch pushes must not
match. Prefer also a protected GitHub Environment with required reviewers.

OTHER MUST-FIXES: (1) inert-and-green -- a skipped job is a green run and release.yml's
gh run watch --exit-status treats it as success, so a tag can cut with the trust path unverified;
add a release-gate assertion that FAILS if trust-e2e was skipped. (2) Provision the 5 repo secrets
on yasyf/daemonkit (USER-GATED -- yasyf's signing key into CI is the user's call; currently []).
(3) Repath ./trust/ -> ./internal/trust/ after P1c. (4) Minors: keychain-restore guard checks the
wrong condition; dead rm -f cert.p12; two fixture-consuming tests outside the 8-name anti-vacuity
list. (5) A genuinely-different-team negative control needs a runner-minted self-signed cert.
